highlights: The historic site of multiple 'please take me back' phone calls, all lovingly unanswered
recommendations: Begging works about 0% of the time, but do try it several times to be thorough

highlights: Parisian cafés: excellent croissants, excellent acoustics for silent treatments
The Seine at night, which has now witnessed more breakup speeches than a therapy room
recommendations: Pack light — the emotional baggage takes up all the overhead bin space

highlights: Gelato consumed in grief — every flavour hits different when you're quietly spiralling
recommendations: Italians invented drama. You fit right in. They are not flattered.

highlights: The Alps — majestic, cold, and emotionally unavailable (finally, something familiar)
Swiss chocolate: the only thing on this trip that didn't disappoint
recommendations: Switzerland is famously neutral — unlike, evidently, your girlfriend
The mountains are an excellent place to contemplate why you are the way you are
Most expensive country in Europe; most expensive mistakes in the trip — consistent

highlights: Berlin's rich history of things collapsing and somehow getting rebuilt — relatable
The autobahn — no speed limits, not unlike how fast this was unravelling
recommendations: Germans are efficient, direct, and unbothered. Take notes. Take many notes.

highlights: Parliament at night, glowing witness to the patch-up that everyone knew was temporary
recommendations: You owe Hungary an apology — it didn't ask to host your reunion scene
Beautiful country. You were not emotionally ready for Europe. Or relationships.

highlights: The Burj Khalifa: the tallest building in the world, and you, alone beneath it
Dubai Marina at golden hour — stunning when shared, merely expensive when not
recommendations: The city is engineered to make you feel small. For once, it required no extra effort.
The shawarma was there for you. The shawarma always is.

highlights: Colombo: visited repeatedly because love and poor financial planning are indistinguishable
Pristine beaches where you fought anyway — the commitment to chaos is honestly impressive
Tea plantations: serene, pastoral, and entirely indifferent to the ongoing situation
recommendations: Flying back and forth for someone who also argues with you upon arrival — bold economics
Sri Lanka is breathtaking; you wouldn't know, you were busy

highlights: Thai beaches that were beautiful and entirely incapable of saving anything
The Land of Smiles — you tested the structural limits of that brand promise
recommendations: Pad thai is warm and dependable. Appreciate what is warm and dependable.
The breakup followed shortly after — Thailand, as always, is not the problem

highlights: 70+ calls, multiple emails, too many drunk nights - all this before we've reached bali
recommendations: Returned heartbroken, as predicted by everyone including the universe
Next time: go alone. Or with a friend. Or with a stranger. Anyone, really.
